critical_concerns.description: No Silent Override is not satisfied: risk_challenge_note.md and final risk_package.json are absent, while codex_round remains PENDING.
Regime Sigma is unusable as reported: CRISIS T=6 cond=4467.6 and CAUTION T=28 cond=268.7, with no bootstrap CI and fallback only recommended rather than evidenced as binding.
Tail-risk caps are breached in the risk-side proxy: CVaR_95=3.67% exceeds 2.5%, CDaR_95=46.14%, MDD=60.46%, and GFC loss=25.93%; deferring these to Optimizer/Forge is a process bypass.
Crowding with STR_1656 fails the stated TDC mandate: lower-tail TDC=0.4796 > 0.30, so the proposed 80/20 PG2 replacement is tail-coupled before optimization.
Sigma factor coverage is below the 30% risk-model expectation: FF5 R2 mean=0.2336, idiosyncratic share=84.2%, and shrinkage intensity delta is not reported.
PIT claims are over-stated: direct parquet cache reads and missing lag lineage make C12/C15/C4 unverifiable for FF5/RMW/CMA construction.
weights.csv is absent, so monthly schedule, max-20 names, long-only, bounds, Sigma-w consistency, and realized turnover cannot be verified.

supporting_arguments: Primary covariance.parquet exists, is symmetric, has min eigenvalue 0.01309044, and condition number exactly 100.0.

RF-R1, RF-R6, and RF-R9 are not triggered on the primary artifacts.

weakest_assumption: The weakest Sigma assumption is that an exact-threshold cond=100 primary factor-model Sigma with only 23.4% factor R2 can safely drive a 20-name optimizer while unstable regime Sigmas are handled by an unenforced pooled fallback.

Provide bootstrap CI or pooled-only binding proof for CAUTION and CRISIS regimes.
Report shrinkage intensity delta and justify factor R2 < 30% without relying on vague shrinkage_quality wording.
Produce weights.csv and verify max_names, bounds, Sigma-w risk, turnover, and schedule.
Re-run PIT audit through sanctioned factor loader or provide C4/C12/C15 lineage evidence for FF5/RMW/CMA.
